Main responsibility

Tharindu is responsible for the admin panel, where admins can review citizen cases, update service information, manage offices/officers, and verify community updates.

Step-by-step tasks
Step 1 — Create admin frontend
npm create vite@latest admin-frontend -- --template react
cd admin-frontend
npm install
npm install axios react-router-dom
npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite


Step 2 — Admin layout
// added lucide-react for high-quality SVG icons in the sidebar, 
//and I've added some sleek animations and modern styling using Tailwind CSS.

Create:

AdminSidebar.jsx
Dashboard.jsx

Sidebar links:

Dashboard
Citizen Cases
Services
Offices
Officer Availability
Crowd Reports
Knowledge Base


Step 3 — Dashboard page

Show cards:

Total Cases
High Risk Cases
Pending Cases
Verified Crowd Reports
Most Requested Service

Use StatCard.jsx.

Step 4 — Citizen cases page

Fetch:

GET /api/v1/cases

Show table:

Case ID
Citizen Name
District
Detected Service
VisitGuard Score
Risk Level
Status
Action

Use RiskBadge.jsx.

Step 5 — Case detail page

Fetch:

GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}

Show:

Citizen problem
AI detected service
Missing documents
VisitGuard score
Recommended steps
Officer/counter details
AI response

Admin can update status:

PATCH /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/status

Status values:

Pending
Need More Information
Ready to Visit
Not Ready
Resolved

Step 6 — Service manager page

Admin can add/update services.

Fields:

Service name
Category
Description
Fee
Processing time
Required documents
Common rejection reasons

Use:

GET /api/v1/services
POST /api/v1/services
Step 7 — Office manager page

Admin can add/update offices.

Fields:

Office name
District
Office type
Address
Contact note

Use:

GET /api/v1/offices
POST /api/v1/offices
Step 8 — Officer availability page

Admin can add/update officer/counter details.

Fields:

Office
Officer role
Room number
Available days
Available time
Status

Use:

GET /api/v1/officers
POST /api/v1/officers
Step 9 — Crowd reports page

Fetch:

GET /api/v1/crowd-reports

Admin can:

Verify report
Reject report
Mark as pending

Use:

PATCH /api/v1/crowd-reports/{report_id}/verify

This supports the Community Feedback Loop.
